youtube.title: 11 Small Charges Added Up to One Big Number
youtube.description:
Money mistakes that hide in plain sight: eleven small charges, none over sixteen dollars, and the one number nobody ever saw.

Arlo opens his card statement and finds eleven things he never remembers buying. This short animated story follows each yes, one evening at a time, and shows why small monthly charges never feel like spending: the pain of paying never arrives, only the total does. Watch for the moment the numbers are added up, and for which charges he keeps.

01:54 Eleven

02:50 The question

Question for the comments: Which of the eleven would you have kept?
